OrientationCard.orientation-text: I help people understand complex situations by guiding them to focus on the problem, share their perspectives, and recognize what really matters.
OrientationCard.orientation-note: From confusion to a shared understanding.

StrategyCard.strategy-text: I analyze the context and develop criteria, priorities, and principles to guide the brand’s communication decisions.
StrategyCard.strategy-note: From understanding to a strategic direction.

DesignCard.design-text: I translate the brand’s needs and direction into concrete, consistent visual identities, systems, and communication tools that can be used over time.
DesignCard.design-note: From direction to a concrete system.
